summary_en: Inotech will cancel 1,000,000 shares on November 30, 2026, reducing outstanding shares by 7.3% to 12,700,000 shares.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: Inotech's Board of Directors resolved on November 10, 2026 to cancel 1,000,000 treasury shares in accordance with Article 178 of the Companies Act. The cancellation will reduce the total issued shares from 13,700,000 to 12,700,000 shares, representing a 7.3% reduction of pre-cancellation outstanding shares. The cancellation is scheduled to become effective on November 30, 2026. Following the cancellation, treasury stock holdings will decline from 2,076,253 shares (15.2% of issued shares) to 1,076,253 shares (8.5% of issued shares).
